name: Budapest
about: Spring/fall are mild and quiet, summer is warm and busiest, winter is cold with festive Christmas markets.
overview: Grand thermal bathhouses and Danube-side architecture, split between hilly Buda and flat, lively Pest.
costOverview: Coffee, transit, and a real sit-down meal all cost noticeably less than Western Europe — one of the best-value capitals on the continent.

specialSeasons.text: Christmas markets fill Vörösmarty Square with mulled wine, crafts and festive lights.
